parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports all other components such as shelves, base, and door.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the entire cabinet together.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood for stability and load distribution.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and its contents, ensuring stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of MDF.
parts.Functional_description: It provides surfaces for storing or organizing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a front panel made of solid wood, attached with hinges and a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet interior and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close the cabinet.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is another internal shelf made of MDF, similar to the previous one, providing additional storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed inside the cabinet, dividing the internal space into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.
